description: Writes to the user's Lab: ask the user before calling, then pass confirm: true. Rename a saved strategy and/or replace its strategy spec (a changed spec makes it a draft again: its earlier backtests stay, tested on the old rules). The server validates the spec and answers with the reason when it refuses. Needs POLYRANK_API_KEY.

confirm.description: Required: true, and only after the user agreed to this call in the conversation.
